title: Attractive but not soft
text:
Attractive but not soft. As far as look, this is very nice. It is pretty and looks good. It goes along with many other items in this print. It seems to be very high quality, as most of their products are.

The porblem is in how it feels. It is really not soft. I was very disappointed. We have many blankets that are both beautiful and soft, so it was disappointing that this was only the first. It would look good as decor, but there are a lot better choices if you want to have something to use. So it depends on what you are using it for as to whether it would work for you.
